info.name: Legion Login Guard
info.summary: Single-shot guard for the login / OAuth grant button
info.description:
Injects a small client-side guard on the Nextcloud login and OAuth2 grant pages that makes the primary submit / "Grant access" button single-shot.
Why: users (esp. on mobile with password autofill) tap "Grant access" repeatedly while the page is still loading. Because NC 33 stores exactly one per-session OAuth grant stateToken, a second submit hits an already-consumed token and 403s ("state token does not match"). Password autofill can itself advance the flow, so the follow-up tap becomes an accidental double-submit.
This app disables the button after the first activation and shows a "Signing in…" state, so a second tap can't fire. Purely additive, no core patching, survives NC upgrades (lives in custom_apps).
info.author: 13th Legion IT (Spooky)
